page.overview:
Who is Crying Bat?

The Crying Bat is a character who appears in the episode "Horse and Ball." James Baxter manages to cheer them up by jogging on his now iconic ball. It is unknown why they were crying in the first place.

It has dark, tan skin, a red small nose, long wings, and a small patch of dark-greyish hair on it's head. It's eye is black, and it's pupil glistens a dark gold colour. It is shown to have full, clean human resembling teeth in one scene, and different teeth in another.
